# Fact sheets: Testland

## alpha_leader

- A corps commander of the fixture country. Source: https://example.org/alpha

## bravo_leader

- A field marshal of the fixture country, known under two ids. Source: https://example.org/bravo

## charlie_leader

- An admiral of the fixture country. Source: https://example.org/charlie

## delta_advisor

- An advisor who also commanded a corps. Source: https://example.org/delta

## echo_admiral

- A navy chief who also commanded a fleet. Source: https://example.org/echo
